name: @ponti-studios/openspeek
description: Convert Markdown to an AAC/M4A narration using OpenRouter neural TTS (Deepgram Flux / Gemini), with local piper and macOS say fallbacks

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/openspeek.js --target node && node --input-type=commonjs -e "var f=require('fs'),p='dist/openspeek.js',c=f.readFileSync(p,'utf8');f.writeFileSync(p,c.replace(/^#!.*$/m,'#!/usr/bin/env node'))"
